findings.message: The claim of 24 months runs past the 12 months the long-term data covers, and no accelerated study is recorded. Q1E admits extrapolation only where accelerated data show no significant change. This project files a clinical-trial application, where the stability data must support the duration of the proposed study rather than a registered shelf life; a claim beyond the data is a gap to justify, not a Q1E registration failure.
